capabilities.purpose: Mediate persistent human-facing dialogue and collaborative interaction.
Inspect repository directories, files, and bounded repository projections.
Read bounded text and structured files from the permitted Savant runtime.
Locate relevant files and source material within the permitted Savant runtime.
Project proposed content against current filesystem content as a diff.
Load and preserve Palaver-local workspace interaction state.
Expose bounded runtime and repository state for the Palaver workstation.
Create, inspect, accept, or reject proposed patch-review records through the existing workflow.
Interpret supported Palaver workstation commands and route them to appropriate runtime behavior.

excluded_ownership.concern: AI provider selection, provider APIs, model orchestration, inference execution
Canonical durable filesystem mutation and controlled execution
Task discovery, planning, readiness, priority, blockers, and task-state authority
Persona, voice identity, pronunciation, accent, and presentation identity
Evidence verification and attestation where established

invariants: Palaver is the human-facing dialogue and development-control interface.
Palaver does not gain authority over data merely by displaying or discussing it.
Provider-specific AI execution is not a canonical Palaver capability.
Canonical durable mutation is not a Palaver-owned capability.
Task authority is not a Palaver-owned capability.
External owner capabilities remain externally owned when Palaver mediates them.
